review_runs.summary: Coherent, practical transaction lesson with valid Bokmål, explained expressions, and practice progressing toward complete exchanges. Selected source has three bounded weaknesses: learner-facing CEFR terminology, an unnecessarily restrictive review word limit, and a required takeaway exchange introduced without a model. Inspected all 14 exercises. Every exercise serves obj-order-and-pay-01: focused tasks practice ordering items, choosing options, specifying quantities, asking prices, stating payment methods, or closing an exchange; guided, integrated, and retrieval tasks combine these transaction skills. No exercise relies on shared topic vocabulary alone.
